description: READ-ONLY: the STRUCTURAL anti-farming lens — short directed CYCLES in this node's verified settlement graph, i.e. addresses that paid each other in a loop so the money returned to where it started (the on-chain signature of wash / self-dealing). Returns each cycle's members, hop count, and `recycledMicro` (the bottleneck that provably circulated), plus totalRecycledMicro and addressesInRings. ADVISORY only: it never enters the rating (which is already conservation-bounded and unfarmable per viewer) and never gates admission — a legitimate mutual-trade loop can also form a cycle. Short cycles only (bounded, total). No input.
name: lawbor_rings
